title: Single-cell data and machine learning prioritize five ferroptosis genes in MASLD
summary: An integrated analysis of six MASLD single-nucleus RNA-seq samples (48,081 cells) with 101 machine-learning combinations (glmBoost plus randomForestSRC best) and SHAP ranking prioritized five core genes: ERBB2, BACH1, RBMS1, NDRG2 and CTSD. The model, trained on GSE48452 (n = 73), reached an average AUC of 0.967 across three cohorts, validated in GSE135251 and GSE89632. There was no wet-lab validation, and pseudotime, virtual knockout and docking results are computational.
ai_technology: 101 two-stage machine-learning combinations (glmBoost plus randomForestSRC best) with SHAP ranking on hdWGCNA module genes

evidence.tested: Model trained on GSE48452 (n = 73) and evaluated on two independent public cohorts, GSE135251 and GSE89632.
evidence.unknown: Experimental confirmation of the five genes; the average AUC includes the training cohort; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Ensemble machine learning ranked ferroptosis-related module genes to select core candidates for MASLD.
